The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Calimondra family]] matriarch [[Vilia Calimondra]] had several top-secret retreat [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in [[Vilia Calimondra's empire|her interstellar empire]] within the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. One of these planets was a lush garden world where even the waters were sweet. The planet's gardens were tended to by large numbers of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. As an avid gardener, the retired Vilia regularly gardened. The planet's [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates were a closely guarded secret and were only available via a secure channel.

According to her granddaughter and fellow Sith Lord [[Arkadia Calimondra]], Vilia had dozens of secret retreat worlds which she regularly alternated every week. During a [[Bequest]] held in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Arkadia offered to send her catatonic and deranged younger brother [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]], one of the former rulers of the [[Dyarchy]], to one of Vilia's top secret retreat worlds. Vilia agreed to the deal and sent the planet's coordinates via a secure channel to her granddaughter. However, Arkadia intended to assassinate Vilia and tried to recruit the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].

When Kerra refused, Arkadia recruited the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]], not knowing that he was a deep cover operative working for Vilia. Vilia ordered Narsk to sabotage her granddaughter's plans and the Bothan convinced Kerra and the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jarrow Rusher]] to stage a [[Siege of Calimondretta|diversionary attack]] on Arkadia's capital city of [[Calimondretta]]. Narsk escaped with Quillan to Vilia's secret retreat planet. After recovering from the escape, Narsk had a private audience with Vilia at one of her gardens where they discussed the events in the Arkadianate and the threat of the Jedi Knight Kerra.
